title: Foundation Year: 2021
body: Verdant Botanicals was founded in Bengaluru in 2021 by a team of biochemists and botanists.

title: Protein Content: 15g per bottle
body: Each 330ml bottle of Verdant Vitality contains exactly 15g of organic pea and brown rice protein.

title: Sweetener Policy: Zero Added Sugar
body: All Verdant Botanicals products contain zero added cane sugar or artificial sweeteners. Sweetened exclusively with organic monk fruit extract.
